interfaceCSS: .selection-popup,.annotation-popup{width:min(360px,calc(100vw - 24px))!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;padding:8px!important;max-height:75vh!important;min-height:0!important;overflow:auto!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px)!important;overscroll-behavior:contain;}.annotation-popup>.preview{width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box;}.selection-popup input,.selection-popup textarea,.selection-popup select,.annotation-popup input,.annotation-popup textarea,.annotation-popup select{box-sizing:border-box;min-width:0;max-width:100%;}.selection-popup .comment,.annotation-popup .comment{overflow-wrap:anywhere;}.selection-popup .annota-fields,.annotation-popup .annota-fields{font:12px/1.4 sans-serif;gap:4px;}.annota-native-comment{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;}.annota-native-comment-input{font:12px/1.4 sans-serif;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;resize:vertical;background:transparent;color:inherit;border:1px solid GrayText;border-radius:4px;padding:4px 6px;}.annota-palette-picker{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin:3px 0;}.annota-color-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;min-width:0;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;cursor:pointer;transform:rotate(var(--annota-button-rotation,0deg));transition:filter .12s,box-shadow .12s;}.annota-color-button::before{content:'';display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;flex:none;border-radius:2px;background:var(--annota-swatch);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);}.annota-color-button:hover{filter:brightness(1.05);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(105,155,210,.5);}.annota-color-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid Highlight!important;outline-offset:3px!important;}.annota-color-button:active{filter:brightness(.9);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.5);}.annota-palette-picker[data-layout=slanted]{--annota-button-rotation:-12deg;}.annota-palette-picker[data-layout=slanted]>.annota-color-button{max-width:140px;}.annota-palette-picker[data-layout=stack]>.annota-color-button{justify-content:flex-start;}
